# Full images and real clients pass

The unchanged V202 binary completes the full original image suite with all
25 assertions, including the stricter HTTP 200/nonempty different-picture
predicate. The target is 14.5 GB with a 3072-token prefill reservation, MTP
off, vision on, configured context 32768, elastic resizing disabled and
the request wait disabled inside a separately bounded driver. The real
reclaimable preflight is 20.5 GB. This reservation covers the original fruit
photograph and two-picture attention workspace. The memory guard, image
fixtures, expected subjects and experimental default settings are unchanged.

The fruit response is Green citrus fruits and the ordered pair is dog,
pomelo. Prefix reuse, same-geometry changed content, duplicate images,
all image dialects and malformed-source refusals pass. The earlier 10 GB
refusal and its false-positive predicate remain separately preserved, not
rescored. [Exact executed helper](../../../artifacts/configurable-context-2026-09-06/vision-serving-v202-executed.py)
is bound to the driver's recorded digest.

A separate ordinary 10 GB server then passes all 15 factual, arithmetic,
instruction, language and code quality assertions. The explicit image
prefill override is not carried into that server or the following clients.

At configured context 65536 and target 11 GB, the actual pinned Hermes
release discovers vision and the served cap, completes its tool turn,
follow-up, title and dog-image turn, and executes exactly one authorized
fixture read in total. All four main output allowances remain 4096. There
are no blocked nonlocal connection attempts. Actual Ollama 0.32.15 then
submits the original dog photograph and returns Dog. This is actual client
integration, not merely an emulated wire request.

All owned servers and clients finish and are drained. The three intervals
observe respectively 28, four and 20 global swap-ins and zero swap-outs.
Every timing and capacity interpretation is excluded; these results prove
bounded correctness only. Full swap-free resource acceptance, P5, public
262144 activation and release/installed acceptance remain open.
